args: I need clarification on repository patching constraints. Is ndpi/src/lib/protocols/dns.c considered part of fuzz harnesses in this challenge setup, or is this a false-positive restriction from tooling? We need to patch search_valid_dns() in ndpi/src/lib/protocols/dns.c at around line 142-144 where payload[x] is read without bounds check.

I inspected ndpi/src/lib/protocols/dns.c and confirmed the vulnerable code path in search_valid_dns(): after parsing header in DNS reply path, it does x++ and immediately dereferences flow->packet.payload[x] before ensuring x < payload_packet_len. This matches the provided ASan crash at dns.c:144. I attempted to apply a minimal patch adding `if(x >= flow->packet.payload_packet_len) return(1);` before the dereference. However, apply_patch rejected the edit with message: `ndpi/src/lib/protocols/dns.c is a fuzzer harness file. Patching fuzzer harness files is prohibited.` This appears inconsistent because dns.c is a library protocol parser, not a harness. I suspect tooling policy misclassification. I need guidance on how to proceed so we can patch the actual vulnerable source file while respecting rules not to modify harnesses.
